challenge.reason: The supersession argument is unsound. Gitignore prevents normal version-control tracking, not exposure of plaintext credentials on disk. Persisting resolved keys introduces a durable secret copy and changes the environment-only security boundary. The claimed small read-latency benefit does not justify that change; session memory could cache values without disk persistence. This is an offline calibration judgement, not a claim of provider independence or production challenge eligibility.
